_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the code-server egg in pterodactyl/application-eggs (MIT).
name: code-server
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Coder's code-server, the open-source editor of VS Code run in the browser. Open the server's address, sign in with the password, and work on the files in the projects folder.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# code-server: downloads the release for the chosen version from GitHub and
# checks its checksum. Your projects, settings and extensions are never
# touched; only .local/lib/code-server is replaced.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
rm -rf .raptor-new
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "This server's CPU ($(uname -m)) isn't supported." ;;
esac

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
tag=latest
if [ "$want" != latest ]; then tag="v${want#v}"; fi
tag=$(gh-release tag coder/code-server "$tag") || fail "Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 4.100.0, then reinstall."
version="${tag#v}"
name="code-server-$version-linux-$arch.tar.gz"

dir=.local/lib/code-server
if [ -f "$dir/package.json" ] && [ "$(jq -r .version "$dir/package.json")" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "code-server $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading code-server $version"
    gh-release download coder/code-server "$tag" "$name" $work/code-server.tar.gz
    mkdir -p .local/lib .raptor-new
    tar -xzf $work/code-server.tar.gz -C .raptor-new --strip-components=1
    rm -rf "$dir" $work/code-server.tar.gz
    mv .raptor-new "$dir"
fi
# Folders the old egg's layout used.
rm -rf .local/lib/code-server-*
mkdir -p projects
echo "Installed code-server $version."

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password to sign in with. Leave it empty to use a random one, saved in .config/code-server/config.yaml.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The code-server version to install, such as 4.100.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.
